# WriteString <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Streams](BlitzBasic-Streams)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WriteString:Void stream:Int32, string:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to write to. |
| `string` | In | String | required | The text to write. |

## Description

Writes a string as its length in 4 bytes followed by its text, without a line ending. Read it back with [ReadString](ReadString).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
file = WriteFile("streams_string_example.tmp")
WriteString file, "Hello"
CloseFile file
Print FileSize("streams_string_example.tmp")
file = ReadFile("streams_string_example.tmp")
Print ReadString$(file)
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "streams_string_example.tmp"
```

```text
9
Hello
```
